title: docs(releases): the v18 landing page — the page check:release-notes needs before 18.0.0-next.0, behind the URL the CLI's @next pointer names
body:
Fixes #22919

Clause-②: no

## What this is

The short v18 landing page that ruling `6049734955` (Q2 → A, on #22085) asks for, written on the maintainer's word on #22919 (release-owned channel 1). It gives the URL `packages/cli/src/utils/protocol-version-gap.ts` sends `@next` installers to (`https://objectstack.ai/docs/releases/v18`) a page behind it, and it is the page `check:release-notes` demands once the version pass writes an `18.x` heading into `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md`. `scripts/check-release-notes.mjs` is not edited; no release action is taken.

Files, v17's folder shape:

- `content/docs/releases/v18/index.mdx` (new): a release-status blockquote, the line's purpose, and the rule for its breaking stages.
- `content/docs/releases/v18/meta.json` (new): `"pages": ["index"]`.
- `content/docs/releases/meta.json`: `"v18"` at the head of `pages`.
- `content/docs/releases/index.mdx`: one line above the v17 line.
- `scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json`: **+1 generated entry, outside the card's declared surface** (see Deviations).

## What the page says, and the source of each claim

| Claim on the page | Source on `main` at `018b077fb` |
| :--- | :--- |
| No GA release yet; the line publishes as `18.0.0-next.N` on npm's `next` tag; `latest` stays on 17.x; a `^17` range never moves; install by `@next` or an exact `18.0.0-next.N` | `.changeset/pre.json` (`"mode": "pre"`, `"tag": "next"`, landed `a87d8be29`, PR #22084); `.changeset/22080-v18-line-opens.md` |
| The line exists for ADR-0131 (its title), staged in one major per its D14 | `docs/adr/0131-…md` D14; the line-opens changeset ("ADR-0131 … lands on this line in stages") |
| Every major goes to `next` at least one RC cycle before `latest` | ADR-0087 D6 |
| Each breaking stage says so in its own changeset, with its migration; those changesets ship as each package's CHANGELOG | the line-opens changeset ("Each stage that breaks something says so in its own changeset, with its own migration"); AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3 |
| `PROTOCOL_VERSION` is `18.0.0`; the handshake admits `'^18'` and refuses `'^17'` | `packages/spec/src/kernel/protocol-version.ts`, landed `4e9fe9ff6` (PR #22215); `.changeset/22130-protocol-18.md` |
| GA exits pre mode and publishes to `latest` | the line-opens changeset ("What ends it") |

The page names no change beyond those landed facts, states no date, and names no 18.x version other than `18.0.0-next.N`. Per H3, the 21 pending changesets carrying an `@objectstack/…: major` line (33 such lines in all) were read as a source for the staging rule and are not transcribed. One wording choice: the banner reads "v18 has no GA release yet" rather than "no v18 release yet". It stays true after `18.0.0-next.0` publishes, which is exactly what this page unblocks, so the page is not stale on its first prerelease.

## H1: the gate this clears fires only on the post-version tree (measured)

`check-release-notes.mjs` reads majors from `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` headings, unanchored, so on this PR's head it is green with or without the page. The red it clears is the version PR's post-version tree. The simulation ran on scratch copies (`git archive` of `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md`, `packages/spec/package.json`, `content/docs/releases`, `content/docs/meta.json` and `content/docs/index.mdx`), with the CHANGELOG given a `## 18.0.0-next.0` heading and `package.json` set to `18.0.0-next.0`, which is the shape the version pass writes. The worktree was not touched.

| tree | `node scripts/check-release-notes.mjs` |
| :--- | :--- |
| base `018b077fb`, as committed | exit 0 |
| base `018b077fb`, simulated post-version | **exit 1** (output below) |
| head `0efecc249`, simulated post-version | **exit 0** (output below) |
| head, simulated post-version, `"v18"` dropped from `meta.json` (control) | exit 1, "v18.mdx exists but is not listed in content/docs/releases/meta.json" |

Without the page:

```
check-release-notes: 1 problem(s)

  • content/docs/releases/v18.mdx (or content/docs/releases/v18/index.mdx) is missing — @objectstack/spec shipped a 18.x release but there is no curated release page. Write it (lead with breaking changes + migration), then add "v18" to content/docs/releases/meta.json.
```

That is the message the triage reading `6087315917` quotes from the scheduled run's log. With the page:

```
check-release-notes: OK — every released major has a curated, navigable release page.
```

The other release-docs gates the post-version step runs, on the same simulated head tree:

- `check-release-page-status`: exit 0.
- `check-release-section-coverage --strict`: exit 0.
- The version-pass rewriter `sync-release-index-currency` (`syncIndex()` on the scratch root): no rewrites, no findings, `index.mdx` byte-identical.

## H2: what `check:release-page-status` asks of this page (measured)

- **During the `next` line: nothing.** `gaMajors()` matches only end-anchored headings, so `## 18.0.0-next.0` is not a GA heading and v18 is outside the set it judges. The `package.json` cross-check skips a prerelease version. It cannot express "no release yet", and it does not need to.
- **At GA it reads exactly two places**: the first blockquote after the frontmatter, and the trailing parenthetical of the `index.mdx` line. The page puts its status in both on purpose. Simulated GA (`## 18.0.0`, version `18.0.0`) with this page unchanged gives exit 1 with three problems: the blockquote never states that an 18.x version is released, and the index status carries the `prerelease-word` and `prerelease-version` signals. So the gate forces the status rewrite at the GA cut. This page cannot go stale silently there, which is the v16/v17 status class the gate was built for.

## Gates

Derived on this diff with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths): 57 commands for the five paths. The 47 the dispatch named are among them; adding `handwritten-docs.json` brought 10 more. All 57 exit 0 on head `0efecc249`. `--ran` with recorded exit codes reads: "57 derived, 57 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". Two prerequisites had to be met first, by building `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/client` and `@objectstack/client-react`. On a fresh tree, `check:docs`, the two `@objectstack/lint` doc gates, `check:docs-transcript-drift` and `check:skill-examples` answer PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3), not a verdict. MDX: the page compiles with `@mdx-js/mdx` 3.1.1. NOT MEASURED: `Build Docs`, which is CI's, and the live URL, because this container's egress denies `objectstack.ai`.

## Deviations

- **`scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json` (+1 line), outside the card's `content/docs/releases/**`.** `check:docs-audit-scope` (in `lint.yml`, Lint & Repo Gates) reds on any hand-written page under `content/docs` that the generated list does not carry. On this branch's first commit it read: "1 hand-written doc(s) exist but are not listed … + content/docs/releases/v18/index.mdx. Fix: node scripts/docs-audit/check-audit-scope.mjs --write". The entry was regenerated with that command. The 17.7.0 release page carried the same one-line companion edit (`21c804c03`, PR #21994). It is its own commit (`62e32ad55`) so the seat can judge it apart from the page. Without it this PR cannot pass the required lint job.
- The card asks this PR to follow SKILL.md's path fork "for a governed path". `content/docs/releases/**` is in no row of `GOVERNED_SURFACES` (`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`), so the fork lands on the ordinary branch, and this body carries no maintainer quick-read section. The PR stays draft for the seat.

## Acceptance notes

- The page links `/docs/upgrading`, not the generated `/docs/protocol-upgrade/18`. That page is built at docs-build time into a gitignored directory, so the offline lychee lane (`check-links.yml`, `--root-dir content`) cannot resolve it in a fresh checkout.
- The "Versioning policy" section of `content/docs/releases/index.mdx` (unchanged here) still says a breaking change ships as a minor release and that `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` fails any pull request declaring a major. In pre mode that guard's RC exemption stands aside, and 21 changesets with a `major` line are pending on `main`. Release-side text; noted for whoever compiles the v18 notes, not edited here (the card asks for one index line).

Labels: `skip-changeset`. The diff moves nothing any package's `files[]` ships.
